annotations.title: Five-Man Units & Team Without a Player (Pro)

description: Use this when the user asks which five-man units an NBA team plays most and how they rate, its best or worst lineups (also in the clutch), or how a team and each teammate did in the games a player missed. Returns, for a team_id, its five-man units by minutes together with their offensive, defensive and net ratings; with `without_player_id`, the games with and without him and each teammate's per-game minutes, points and usage on both sides, by the minutes gained. Requires Keel Stats Pro; the answer says so when the account has none. Not for one player's on/off: use player_splits_and_on_off.

min_minutes.description: Optional: units with at least this many minutes together (default 20, the clutch 5).

phase.description: Units over every minute ("all", default), the clutch, or without garbage time.

season.description: Optional season year. Defaults to the current season.

type.description: Units of the regular season (default) or the playoffs.

without_player_id.description: Optional numeric player ID: the team in the games he missed, against the games he played.
